name: visual-companion
description: Show a person what you mean instead of describing it. The agent puts screens, mockups and clickable prototypes in a browser window beside the chat. The person leaves notes on the exact spot they want changed and presses Send, and the agent picks them up and keeps going. It runs a small web server on this computer only, with no share or guest links. Any page this renders can message the agent that owns it. Don't open pages you don't trust.
author: Dork Labs
